newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-UKIO BANK H1 1997 NET PROFIT RISES.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-UKIO BANK H1 1997 NET PROFIT RISES.

text.p: Lithuania's Ukio Bank said on Thursday that its net profit in the first half of the year rose to 1.65 million litas from 579,000 litas in the same period in 1996.
Chief financial officer Petrs Velichka told Reuters that the assets of the bank rose to 216.85 million litas at the end of June from 197.33 million litas at the beginning of the year.
The loan portfolio of the bank stood at 156.41 million litas at the end of June compared to 146.56 million litas at the beginning of the year, Velichka said.
He also said that the deposits of the bank increased to 168.06 million litas at the end of June from 145.18 million litas at the beginning of 1997.
The current share capital of the bank stands at 42 million litas and the bank said earlier it was planning a share capital boost of 18 million litas in the second half of 1997.
